Welcome to the live broadcast of the 14th round of the Ukrainian Premier League, where Dynamo Kyiv hosts LNZ Cherkasy at the Valeriy Lobanovskyi Dynamo Stadium. This is a clash between one of the league leaders and an ambitious mid-table side that has already caused problems for the giants.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 13:30 UTC 16:30 MSK Stadium: Valeriy Lobanovskyi Dynamo Stadium, Kyiv Competition: Ukrainian Premier League

Dynamo Kyiv vs LNZ Cherkasy: Match Preview

Dynamo comes into this match as one of the league leaders, competing for the gold medals. Oleksandr Shovkovskyi's team has shown consistent results and is particularly dominant at home. LNZ, in turn, is a solid mid-table team known for its resilience and organized play. Midweek, the Kyiv side had a tough match in the Conference League, which could affect the players' physical condition. The head-to-head history between these teams includes only a few matches, but last season LNZ managed to take points from Dynamo at home with a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Dynamo Kyiv

The Kyiv team will be highly motivated to secure three points to keep pace with their rivals in the title race. The team relies on ball possession and fast wing attacks, led by Andriy Yarmolenko and Vladyslav Vanat. Despite potential fatigue after their European fixture, Dynamo's squad depth allows them to remain the clear favorite in matches against mid-table teams.

LNZ Cherkasy

The team, managed by Oleg Dulub, is known for its pragmatic style and ability to play on the counter. LNZ will focus on a tight defense and fast breaks. The Cherkasy squad features a group of experienced players who came through the Dynamo academy, which will add extra spice to the match. The visitors will try to take advantage of their opponent's fatigue and impose a gritty, tough battle.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Dynamo Kyiv 4-2-3-1: Bushchan; Tymchyk, Popov, Syrota, Dubinchak; Brazhko, Shaparenko; Yarmolenko, Buyalskyi, Voloshyn; Vanat.
  • LNZ Cherkasy 5-4-1: Kucherenko; Stasiuk, Muravskyi, Kovalyov, Salihu, Norenkov; Naumets, Rybalka, Boiko, Pasich; Pryadun.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although LNZ is a tricky and organized opponent, Dynamo are the undisputed favorites on their home turf. The difference in class, the home-field advantage, and tournament motivation should be decisive. It will not be easy for the Kyiv side to break down the visitors' packed defense, but their individual skill in attack should make the difference.

  • Main Prediction: Dynamo Kyiv to Win. The Kyiv side is in the title race and cannot afford to drop points in a home match against a mid-table team, even despite fatigue from European competition.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. LNZ, under Oleg Dulub, is known for its defense and ability to 'dry out' games. A tight contest with a small number of goals is expected.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 14:00 UTC 17:00 MSK Stadium: Villa Park, Birmingham Competition: English Premier League

Aston Villa vs AFC Bournemouth: Match Preview

Aston Villa comes into this match as one of the league leaders. Unai Emery's side has shown consistent results and is competing for the top spots. Midweek, the Birmingham side had a tough match in the Europa League, which could affect the players' physical condition. Bournemouth, on the other hand, is one of the underdogs, sitting in 16th place and fighting for survival. The 'Cherries' have lost their last two matches, including a 6-1 defeat to Manchester City in the previous round. The head-to-head history favors Bournemouth, who have won four of the last six Premier League encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Aston Villa

Under Unai Emery, the 'Villans' have become a formidable force, especially at home, winning 12 of their last 13 Premier League matches. However, Villa faces notable injury issues: Emiliano Buendía, Youri Tielemans, and Tyrone Mings will miss the game. Despite these absences and midweek fatigue, the hosts will aim for another home victory to stay among the league's elite.

AFC Bournemouth

Andoni Iraola's side continues to struggle, particularly away from home, where they've lost four of five matches this season, conceding 15 goals. The team's main weakness is their defense. Against one of the league's best home sides, Bournemouth will likely rely on a deep, defensive approach to limit damage.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Genoa vs Fiorentina: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 12th round of the Italian Serie A, where Genoa hosts Fiorentina at their Stadio Luigi Ferraris. This is a crucial confrontation between two teams from the lower part of the league table, both in desperate need of points for their relegation battle.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 14:00 UTC 17:00 MSK Stadium: Stadio Luigi Ferraris, Genoa Competition: Serie A

Genoa vs Fiorentina: Match Preview

Both teams come into this head-to-head meeting from the relegation zone. Genoa is in 18th place with 6 points, while Fiorentina is at the bottom of the table in 20th, with only 4 points. However, the teams are in different psychological states. Genoa secured their first win of the season in the last round, sensationally defeating Sassuolo 2-1 away with a last-minute goal. Fiorentina, on the other hand, is in a deep crisis: the team has yet to win in this Serie A campaign and has suffered three consecutive defeats, including a midweek loss in the Conference League. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Viola, who are unbeaten against the Grifone in nine matches and have won 5 of the last 6 encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Genoa

The long-awaited first victory should have given confidence to Daniele De Rossi's side. However, Genoa has one of the league's weakest attacks, having scored just six goals in ten matches. At home, the team has been winless for eight consecutive games. Despite this, they will look to build on their success and earn vital points in this 'six-pointer.'

Fiorentina

The Viola are enduring one of the worst starts in their history. The team remains winless, concedes often, and struggles offensively, failing to score in three of their last five away fixtures. Despite their issues, Fiorentina still boasts a stronger squad and will be determined to end their miserable streak.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Genoa 3-5-2: Martinez; De Winter, Bani, Vasquez; Sabelli, Frendrup, Badelj, Malinovskyi, Martin; Gudmundsson, Retegui.
  • Fiorentina 4-2-3-1: Terracciano; Kayode, Milenkovic, Martinez Quarta, Parisi; Arthur, Duncan; Ikone, Bonaventura, Gonzalez; Nzola.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two struggling sides in contrasting moods is difficult to predict. Genoa is motivated after their first victory but has a poor home record. Fiorentina is in crisis but has historically dominated this fixture.

  • Main Prediction: Fiorentina Double Chance X2. Despite their poor form, Fiorentina has more quality and a superior head-to-head record. The visitors should at least avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Both teams have struggled to score. Eight of Genoa's last ten matches have gone under this line. Expect a tight, low-scoring game.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the English Premier League, where Brentford hosts Newcastle United at their Gtech Community Stadium. This is a meeting of two mid-table teams aiming to improve their positions.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 14:00 UTC 17:00 MSK Stadium: Gtech Community Stadium, London Competition: English Premier League

Brentford vs Newcastle United: Match Preview

Both teams come into this head-to-head meeting in less than ideal form. Brentford lost to Tottenham in the last round, which ended their three-match winning streak. Newcastle, in turn, had a grueling Champions League match against Athletic Bilbao in midweek, where they suffered a defeat while playing with a man down. The Magpies are winless in their last four matches across all competitions. The head-to-head history favors Newcastle, who have won four of the last five encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Brentford

The Bees, under Thomas Frank, are traditionally strong at home. The team relies on high pressing and fast counter-attacks. At their home stadium, Brentford has lost only once in their last six matches. However, the team has significant personnel problems, with Rico Henry, Kevin Schade, Josh Dasilva, and others out with injuries.

Adding to their physical fatigue after the Champions League match is an injury crisis, with Sven Botman, Alexander Isak, Harvey Barnes, and others unavailable. Newcastle will be eager to end their winless streak, but doing so away against a strong Brentford side will be very difficult.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 14:30 UTC 17:30 MSK Stadium: Akhmat Arena, Grozny Competition: Russian Premier League

Akhmat Grozny vs Spartak Moskva: Match Preview

The teams come into this head-to-head meeting in different moods. Spartak is in a deep crisis, having suffered four consecutive defeats in the RPL and dropping to 9th place in the table. Midweek, the 'Red-Whites' also lost the first leg of the Russian Cup quarter-final to Lokomotiv. Akhmat, in contrast, has gained good momentum, being unbeaten in their last three league rounds (two wins, one draw), which has allowed the team to climb to 11th place. The head-to-head history favors Spartak, but last season Akhmat managed to take points from the Moscow side at home with a 0-0 draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Akhmat Grozny

Magomed Adiev's team traditionally performs strongly at home. Akhmat relies on physical football, high pressing, and fast counter-attacks. The Grozny side will aim to take advantage of Spartak's crisis and extend their unbeaten streak. The leader of Akhmat's attack is striker Mohamed Konaté, who is in good form.

Spartak Moskva

The Red-Whites are going through one of their worst spells in recent years. Five consecutive defeats across all competitions are putting immense pressure on the team and head coach Dejan Stanković. Spartak's main issues are their lack of attacking efficiency and frequent defensive mistakes. Adding to their troubles are key absences in defense, with Srđan Babić and Georgi Dzhikiya sidelined due to injuries.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Welcome to the live broadcast of the Madrid derby in the 13th round of the Spanish La Liga, where Rayo Vallecano hosts Real Madrid at their cozy Campo de Vallecas stadium. This is always a tense and uncompromising confrontation, where the small club from a working-class Madrid neighborhood challenges its illustrious neighbor.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 15:15 UTC 18:15 MSK Stadium: Campo de Vallecas, Madrid Competition: La Liga

Rayo Vallecano vs Real Madrid: Match Preview

The teams approach the derby in different conditions. Real Madrid, under Xabi Alonso, is having a phenomenal season, leading La Liga and maintaining a perfect record in the Champions League. Midweek, Los Blancos earned a comeback victory at Anfield against Liverpool 2-1. Rayo Vallecano, meanwhile, sits mid-table under Iñigo Pérez, winless in their last three matches. The head-to-head record is heavily in favor of Real, who have won 12 of the last 13 meetings, though their only defeat came on their last visit to Vallecas, when Rayo stunned them 3-2.

Team Form and Analysis

Rayo Vallecano

The Red Sashes are known for their bold, attacking football, especially at home. The team will be eager to repeat last year's upset and claim points against the giants again. However, their defensive weaknesses are evident: Rayo have conceded 13 goals in their last five games. The main attacking threat comes from veteran striker Raúl de Tomás.

Real Madrid

Los Blancos are in tremendous form, with 14 wins in their last 15 matches. However, injuries are affecting their defense - Dani Carvajal, Antonio Rüdiger, and David Alaba are all unavailable. After the exhausting trip to Liverpool, Xabi Alonso may opt for some rotation. Still, the attacking trio of Kylian Mbappé, Vinícius Júnior, and Rodrygo is capable of deciding any match.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Rayo Vallecano 4-2-3-1: Dimitrievski; Balliu, Mumin, Lejeune, Espino; Valentín, López; Palazón, Trejo, García; De Tomás.
  • Real Madrid 4-3-3: Courtois; Vázquez, Militão, Nacho, García; Modrić, Tchouaméni, Kroos; Rodrygo, Joselu, Díaz.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Real Madrid's clear superiority, this match could be a challenging one for the visitors. Rayo are known for their passion and intensity at home, and Real's fatigue and injuries might make things tricky.

  • Main Prediction: Both Teams to Score. Rayo have found the net in nine of their last ten home matches, and Real's defensive issues suggest another open game. At the same time, Madrid's attack should not be underestimated.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The last five clashes at Vallecas have all been high-scoring. With Rayo's attacking intent and Real's firepower, another goal-filled encounter is expected.

Manchester City vs Liverpool: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main event of the 11th Premier League matchday, and arguably the entire first half of the season, as Manchester City hosts Liverpool at the Etihad Stadium. This is a battle between the two main pursuers of league leaders Arsenal, occupying second and third places in the table.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 16:30 UTC 19:30 MSK Stadium: Etihad Stadium, Manchester Competition: English Premier League

Manchester City vs Liverpool: Match Preview

The teams come into this clash at the peak of their form and as neighbors in the table – City are second with 19 points, and Liverpool are third with 18. The Citizens have shown immense power, winning six of their last seven matches, including a 4-1 thrashing of Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League. At the Etihad, Pep Guardiola's team has won nine of their last ten Premier League matches. Liverpool, on the other hand, have bounced back from an early slump, securing two consecutive clean-sheet victories, including one against Real Madrid. However, Arne Slot's side has lost their last three away league games and will be eager to end this streak. Adding spice to the matchup is the fact that Liverpool defeated City twice last season, both 2-0.

Team Form and Analysis

Manchester City

The Citizens look almost unstoppable, particularly at home. The attack led by Erling Haaland, the league’s top scorer, is in phenomenal shape. Interestingly, City are the only team in the league yet to score from a set piece — all 20 goals have come from open play. The squad is nearly at full strength, with only Rodri’s participation uncertain.

Liverpool

The Reds are returning to their top level. Wins over Aston Villa and Real Madrid without conceding have boosted their confidence. The main task for Arne Slot is to end Liverpool’s away losing streak, something not seen since 2012. Liverpool will also look to claim a third consecutive league victory over City for the first time since 1991.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Benfica vs Casa Pia: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the Portuguese Primeira Liga, where Lisbon's Benfica hosts Casa Pia at Estádio da Luz. This is a clash between one of the league’s leaders and a team battling relegation.

Kick-off: November 9, 2025, 20:30 UTC 23:30 MSK Stadium: Estádio da Luz, Lisbon Competition: Primeira Liga

Benfica vs Casa Pia: Match Preview

The teams come into this match from opposite ends of the table. Benfica sits third and continues to chase the top spots, remaining one of only two unbeaten teams this season. In their last round, the Eagles crushed Vitória S.C. 3-0 and have won four consecutive league games with a combined score of 13-0. However, midweek, they suffered a 1-0 loss to Bayer Leverkusen in the Champions League. Casa Pia are 16th, winless in five matches, and have lost two in a row. The head-to-head record favors Benfica, though the last encounter ended in a shock 3-1 win for Casa Pia.

Team Form and Analysis

Benfica

The Eagles will be eager to redeem themselves after their European defeat. They boast the league’s third-best attack and second-best defense, remaining unbeaten at home this season. However, they will miss suspended captain Nicolás Otamendi, while several players including Alex Bah are sidelined through injury.

Casa Pia

The Geese are in crisis. Winless in five games, they possess one of the worst defenses in the league, conceding 22 goals. In their last three matches alone, they have let in 11. Facing one of Portugal’s strongest attacking sides away will be a daunting challenge.
